messages:
Nora Vega: Heads-up: finalizing run-of-show for June webinar. Need one-sentence landing, 2-line abstracts, and who owns customer clip.
Samir Rao: I'll coordinate customer clip with AtlasAI. They can do a 45s testimonial.
Eli Turner: Abstract (2 lines): 'Optimizing inference economics: real tradeoffs between batching, KV cache and quantization with measured outcomes.'
Mina Park: Rehearsal windows? I prefer mornings.
Nora Vega: Proposed run-of-show (30m):
00:00-02:00 Intro + agenda (Olivia)
02:00-10:00 Measured benchmarks & charts (Eli)
10:00-18:00 Customer story clip + quick Q (Samir + AtlasAI)
18:00-26:00 Live demo: Optimize panel + routing (Mina)
26:00-30:00 CTA + poll + close (Nora)
Mina Park: Demo needs clear fallback: pre-recorded screen share + static slides.
ops-bot: Runbook entry created: fallback_video -> s3://redwood-webinars/1723/fallback.mp4
Olivia Chen: Please keep demos <8m. Also need headshot + 1-liner bio by Fri noon.
Samir Rao: AtlasAI clip ETA Thu EOD. I'll confirm approvals.
Eli Turner: I'll shrink slides to 6 and add alt text for charts.
Nora Vega: Poll idea: 'Which optimization would you try first? A) Batching B) KV caching C) Quantization D) Routing'
Mina Park: Rehearsal slots: Mon 9-9:30am PT dry run, Wed 10-11am PT full run.
ops-bot: Calendar invites sent and recording enabled for rehearsals.
Olivia Chen: Who will run the poll live?
Eli Turner: I can trigger the poll and monitor results.
Nora Vega: Ops: please provide a 10-sample smoke test 30m before show (tokens ~120).
ops-bot: Smoke test template added: `python smoke_test.py --host demo.redwood.ai --model rdx-13b --samples 10`. Results post to #marketing-webinars.
Samir Rao: Will upload customer quote and clip link once received.
Mina Park: Adding troubleshooting checklist to runbook (timeouts, model fallback, screen-share steps).
Olivia Chen: Draft social copy for review by EOD today. Keep landing desc <=120 chars.
Eli Turner: Landing suggestion: 'Real-world playbook to lower LLM inference cost + live demos and customer results.'
Nora Vega: Great. Final: all assets (headshots, bios, slides, clip) into assets folder by Fri 12pm. Ping me for urgent changes. :rocket:
